headings.treatment: Bold italic uppercase with a signature gold underline. Use relative positioning with an absolute gold pseudo-element or border-bottom for the underline. Avoid standard centering unless explicitly requested (e.g., nav logo).

scales.subheading: text-lg md:text-xl font-semibold text-[#4A7FB5] uppercase tracking-wider

visual_enhancers.borders: Crisp 1px solid #C9A227 for images and critical panels. Avoid soft radii; stick to sharp 0px corners or max 4px for a rugged, industrial precision.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders and contrasting dark panel backgrounds (#1C1C1C on #121212) instead of soft drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: High contrast, desaturated monochrome feel. Apply a `grayscale contrast-125 brightness-75` CSS filter to standard images if they are too colorful, allowing only the UI gold/blue to pop.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Gold accent (#C9A227) for interactive text. Buttons with gold borders transition to solid gold fill with #121212 text on hover.

layouts.spacing: Generous. p-8, p-12, py-24. High density in forms, expansive in hero and manifesto.
layouts.grid: CSS Grid for 'Your Experience' (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3). Asymmetric bento style optionally for mission.
layouts.alignment: Strict left alignment for content, mimicking editorial layouts. Asymmetric layouts over centered Bootstrap styles.

motion.hero: On-load masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (wrap text lines in overflow-hidden divs and translate Y). Subtle 3D parallax on the hero image (Framer Motion useScroll/useTransform).
motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling for premium momentum.
motion.interactions: Hover states on the 'Your Experience' cards: slight image scale within a hidden overflow, border color shift.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an editorial ribbon if needed, slow smooth drift.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text colors meet AA standard. Text over images must have dark gradient overlays (bg-black/60).

nav.design: Centered logo, links Home/Services/About/Contact. Background #1C1C1C/90 with backdrop-blur-xl (Glassmorphism). Nav labels uppercase letter-spaced.

hero.design: Full-width B&W motorcycle banner. Logo overlaid + dark gradient (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#121212] via-[#121212]/50 to-transparent). Parallax effect on scroll.

mission.design: Photo left with 1px gold border. Heading (gold underlined) + paragraph + gold-outline 'Learn More' button right.

experience.design: Transport / Detailing / Storage steps. Steel blue sub-heading (#4A7FB5). Description. Gold-bordered photo. 'Learn More' link. Gold dividers flank the main title.

carousel.design: Horizontal. 4-5 photos, arrow nav, autoplay. Framer motion or Embla carousel.

contact.design: bg-[#1C1C1C]. Left: Contact Form (First/Last name, Email, Phone, Message, gold Send button). Right: 'Contact Us' heading, phone, address, hours, embedded Google Map, Instagram/Facebook icons.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or sticky headers. Always use solid (#1C1C1C) or heavily blurred (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#1C1C1C]/90) backgrounds.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep borders sharp (0px or 4px radius max for brutalist/moto feel).
Never use generic centered layouts except for the nav logo and 'The Delta Way' section title. Asymmetry creates tension, tension creates interest.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
For the signature gold underline: use a custom span with absolute bottom border or underline offset with #C9A227 color.
Masked line-by-line reveal: Wrap lines in overflow-hidden divs and animate the inner text sliding up using framer-motion.
Contact form: raw html/tailwind or heavily customized shadcn. Inputs should be transparent bg with bottom borders or solid dark #1C1C1C with 1px gold border on focus. Yellow gold submit button.
Never use generic placeholders. Use the provided image URLs.
Typography MUST use Oswald or Anton for headings, styled as Bold Italic Uppercase.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build exactly as requested. Start with raw HTML/Tailwind for the layouts, avoid restrictive Shadcn Card wrappers for creative sections. Install framer-motion and lenis for scroll interactions. The gold-underline on italic uppercase Oswald/Anton headings is a signature piece—nail it. Desaturate the placeholder images using CSS filters (e.g., `grayscale contrast-125 brightness-75`) if they are too colorful, and allow the gold and blue accents to pop.
